description: Test suite for CPA (Custom Profile Attributes) field commands in Mattermost's CLI, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting CPA fields with various scenarios and error handling.

methods.name: TestCPAFieldListCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for listing CPA fields, including normal, empty, error, and conversion failure scenarios.

methods.name: TestCPAFieldCreateCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for creating CPA fields with various attributes, options, JSON attrs, and error handling.

methods.name: TestCPAFieldEditCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for editing CPA fields, including updating name, managed flag, attrs, options, and error scenarios.

methods.name: TestCPAFieldDeleteCmd
methods.description: Unit tests for deleting CPA fields by ID or name, including confirmation, not found, and API errors.
